name: Organic Synthesis & Retrosynthesis
summary: Planning and executing the synthesis of target molecules, including stereocontrol and protecting-group strategy.

topics.name: Retrosynthetic analysis: disconnections, synthons and synthetic equivalents
Carbon-carbon bond formation: enolate, organometallic and olefination methods
Stereoselective synthesis: substrate control and chiral auxiliaries
Asymmetric catalysis: hydrogenation, epoxidation, aldol reactions
Convergent vs linear synthesis; step and atom economy
Classic total syntheses as case studies
